analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - November 18, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: Rating changes: Telefonica Brasil (VIV) upgraded to Neutral from Sell on better cost control and signs of gradual competition stabilization. Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB.AD) upgraded to Buy from Neutral. Whitbread (WTB.L) upgraded to Buy from Neutral. Technip Energies (TE.PA) downgraded to Neutral from Buy.
Europe Energy (Della Vigna): oil services LNG FID wave is getting bigger. GTT is the preferred exposure and Technip Energies moves to Neutral.

Nvidia (NVDA, Buy), Schneider: strong outlook despite uncertainty, with a steady commitment to balancing shareholder returns and ecosystem support. Japan electronics analysts (Takayama) say the NVDA read-across gives reassurance on the earnings outlook and product roadmap.
Macro: US Inflation Monitor (Rindels), October 2026, is titled 'A Third Month of Worse Inflation News'. EM Market Outlook 2027 (Trivedi) is titled 'Diversified Gains, Fewer Bargains'.

Occidental Petroleum (OXY): Houston takeaways describe a self-help story on track. Maintain Buy, on the Conviction List. Americas Energy Services (Mehta): international activity and North America pricing support the 2027 outlook, with HAL highlighted.
Healthcare Services (Fidel): CMS unveils CRUSH, a proposed rule targeting fraud, waste and abuse in Medicare/Medicaid/Marketplace (Care/Caid/HIX).
China Internet (Keung): initial take on the US BIS remote-access rule and its implications. A separate note covers demand-shift implications for ASEAN data centers.

Consumer: Amer Sports (AS) 3Q26 momentum is broad-based, with an initial FY27 framework pointing to continued growth and reinvestment. Nike held an Investor Day. Viking Holdings (VIK) 3Q26 review: expectations reset, long-term thesis intact, Maintain Buy.
Home Depot (HD): solid 3Q26 same-store sales, with the FY26 margin guide revised slightly lower. Americas retail sales were in line with consensus in October, with September restated slightly higher.
Disney (DIS) F4Q26 review: beat and reiterate provides a solid setup for outperformance in F2027.
Builders FirstSource (BLDR) Investor Day: near-term trough largely discounted, with strategic efforts unlocking asymmetric upside.
Klarna (KLAR) 3Q26: shares outperform on reiteration of guidance and a strong quarter-to-date read.

Target price changes of 10% or more: ADIB.AD to 27.50 from 23.36, Big Yellow (Sell) to 840 from 740, Whitbread to 3700 from 2700, Asus (Neutral) to 1000 from 1115, Weibo (WB, Neutral) to $5.80 from $6.70, Weibo 9898.HK to HK$45 from HK$52.

European results: ConvaTec trading update confirms improving growth and FY26 guidance upgraded. Experian 1H27 results broadly in line with EPS ahead, outlook adjusted, new $500m buyback. Smiths Group guidance confirmed, Buy. British Land FY27 EPS guidance upgraded.
M&A and corporate events: Puig reportedly in final talks to acquire Parfums de Marly. Eurobank announces acquisition of Fibank. Shiseido announces sale of its China Aupres business.

Asia: Taiwan ODM/Brands note says AI server demand continues to ramp in 4Q26 while PCs remain weak on high memory cost and material shortage. Miniso 3Q26 beat with guidance unchanged. Weibo 3Q26 revenue and operating profit in line, EPS missed on non-operating items, ad revenue pressure likely to persist into 2027.
Fosun Pharma AR1001 Alzheimer's Phase 3 delivered mixed results, with commercial potential hinging on the FDA path.
